python3 - << 'PY'
# NASA outlays (millions of dollars) from FFO-3 table, FY 2008-2017
# Source: treasury_bulletin_2012_12_page_24.txt (FY2008-2012)
# Source: treasury_bulletin_2017_12_page_22.txt (FY2013-2017)
nasa_millions = [17834, 19168, 18906, 17617, 17190, 16978, 17093, 18272, 18828, 18698]

# Convert to billions
nasa_billions = [x / 1000 for x in nasa_millions]
print("NASA outlays (billions):", nasa_billions)
print("Sorted:", sorted(nasa_billions))

n = len(nasa_billions)
print(f"\nn = {n}")

# 10% winsorization: 
# k = floor(n * p) = floor(10 * 0.10) = floor(1) = 1 observation from each tail
# Lower bound: 10th percentile (p=0.10), position = (n-1)*p + 1 = 9*0.10 + 1 = 1.9
# Upper bound: 90th percentile (p=0.90), position = (n-1)*p + 1 = 9*0.90 + 1 = 9.1
# These use Type 7 / linear interpolation (default)

# Position h = (n-1)*p + 1 for p-th percentile
import statistics

def percentile_type7(data, p):
    """Type 7 (R/pandas default; linear interpolation)"""
    sorted_data = sorted(data)
    n = len(sorted_data)
    h = (n - 1) * p + 1
    # h = 1.9 for p=0.10 with n=10
    lower_idx = int(h) - 1  # 0-indexed, so lower_idx = 1 - 1 = 0
    frac = h - int(h)
    return sorted_data[lower_idx] + frac * (sorted_data[lower_idx + 1] - sorted_data[lower_idx])

p10 = percentile_type7(nasa_billions, 0.10)
p90 = percentile_type7(nasa_billions, 0.90)
print(f"\n10th percentile (Type 7): {p10}")
print(f"90th percentile (Type 7): {p90}")

# Winsorize: replace values below p10 with p10, and above p90 with p90
winsorized = []
for v in nasa_billions:
    if v < p10:
        winsorized.append(p10)
    elif v > p90:
        winsorized.append(p90)
    else:
        winsorized.append(v)

print(f"\nWinsorized values: {winsorized}")
print(f"Min after winsorization: {min(winsorized)}")
print(f"Max after winsorization: {max(winsorized)}")

winsorized_range = max(winsorized) - min(winsorized)
print(f"\n10% Winsorized range: {winsorized_range}")
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {round(winsorized_range, 2)}")
